card: Backports four merged master PRs (#36230, #36297, #36309, and #36316) to the 32.x release branch. It improves wallet descriptor lookup performance by caching SHA-256 hashes of canonical descriptor strings, corrects invalid OpenRPC default argument schemas, designates private transaction broadcast as experimental, and aligns Nix Windows CI builds with Guix POSIX thread models while increasing CI log limits. All constituent commits have previously merged into master.
changed_since_previous: Added commits backporting #36316 ('ci: use POSIX threads for Nix Windows builds'), which configures POSIX threading for Nix Windows cross-builds and raises BuildKit per-step log limits.
evidence: Commit 7fdb8584da notes: 'The canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... further hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash.'

Commit 7a0964a252 notes: 'The getdeploymentinfo blockhash fallback and four sighashtype fallbacks describe how omitted arguments are resolved. They are not literal values accepted by the RPCs, so mark them as DefaultHint values.'

Commit 6854ead11c notes: 'Guix release binaries use the POSIX GCC thread model, but the pinned Nixpkgs cross compiler defaults to MCF. Select POSIX through the Nixpkgs threads hook so GCC and its target libraries agree.'
problem: The 32.x release branch lacks fixes and improvements merged to master: descriptor comparison in `HasWalletDescriptor` repeatedly serializes strings, OpenRPC schema metadata treats non-literal fallback descriptions as literal default values, private transaction broadcast overstates origin concealment without an experimental warning, and Nix Windows CI builds fail to match Guix release POSIX thread models and suffer from truncated BuildKit logs.

risk.why: A flaw in wallet descriptor canonical hashing could fail descriptor lookups or updates, but the commits are identical to changes already merged to master.

scope_notes: A backport PR containing 14 commits across four distinct areas (wallet, RPC documentation, docs, and Nix CI) that have already been reviewed and merged into master.
summary: Backports four merged master pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36230, #36297, #36309, and #36316). The bundle caches canonical descriptor string hashes to speed up wallet descriptor lookups, fixes OpenRPC metadata defaults, marks private broadcast as experimental while scoping its privacy claims, and aligns Nix Windows cross-builds to POSIX threads in CI.
